scope.functionality: All product functionality retained; existing responsive, keyboard/accessibility and Windows support retained.

source_fingerprint.algorithm: SHA-256 over sorted tracked source/test/workflow paths, NUL, and raw SHA-256 of each file; cmd/internal/desktop/hub/tests/testdata/tools/.github/workflows plus go.mod/go.sum/Makefile. Documentation receipts excluded.

checks.scope: Complete root race suite plus production observation-byte/streaming boundaries and FHIR/proof labs.

journeys.corrective_command: GOMAXPROCS=2 GOFLAGS='-p=2' npm run test:journeys -- src/journeys/reusable-work.journey.tsx --maxWorkers=1
journeys.evidence_scope: Combined full-run and corrected affected-workflow results, not a claim of a single entirely green full run. The editor-read defect found by the full run is fixed and its whole five-test workflow passes.

tests.test: a comparison is read under a named normalization policy exactly as readmit normalize reads it, a rule the reader refuses is refused before anything is saved, and the extended policy is what the command line reads
two cases are compared exactly as readmit diff reports them, a mismatched pair is refused with the key to declare, and a case changed after import is refused as the command line refuses it
a crash while a send waits on its acknowledgement leaves the delivery uncertain, and reopening never sends it again
a test half authored when the application ended comes back for its case and is finished from where it was
a delivered license is verified, installed and activated without hand-written configuration, and once released admits no new work
an expired term refuses new work until the later issue the vendor signs is installed, and a term in its grace period still admits it
the commercial portal is an operator-supplied destination: stated as missing, refused when invalid, and once chosen shown as a link that survives a restart
a send policy and a reset plan are saved under the identity of their bytes, refused when invalid, and read unchanged by target check and the reset reader
credential references are registered, refused, edited, cancelled and bound in the window and read unchanged by the command line
a test of an independent downstream system fails on its defect, passes once it is fixed and fails again when the defect returns
the downstream's exported state is observed through a declared window, and missing, stale and incomplete exports are errors, never an empty result
checks suggested from a passing run are added only as a person accepts them, a failed run proposes nothing, a cancelled review adds nothing, and the command line runs what was saved
a 10,000-message case is read one window at a time with no index set up, and a case changed between two reads is refused
the guided sample is authored, fails on the defect, passes once it is corrected and reopens with both verdicts
a call Wails would reject fails the journey, though the window reports it only as unreachable
a crash abandons the window at once, and the next launch starts from what was on disk
a dialog the journey did not answer fails the journey instead of opening nothing quietly
a dismissed dialog is a cancellation that opens nothing
a journey changes only a file that is already on the machine, in place
an answer scripted for another dialog is refused and fails the journey
closing a window whose call never finished fails the journey and names the call
no journey can place, change, age or export a file or an activation folder outside its own root
markup in evidence, file names and searches is shown as inert text and never becomes an element
the hub administration handoff reads a real configuration and never runs its host step
a chosen hub configuration is restored selected and offline when the window is reopened, and reopening reaches nothing
a remembered hub configuration that stopped validating is shown with why after a reopen, and choosing one again recovers
Team views on a real hub work from the keyboard and in a compact window, ask before discarding an edited comment, keep it through a stopped hub, and record a retried decision once under its intent
a support summary the team approved downloads from a real hub byte for byte, and the person's notifications and searches read what the hub recorded

an operator stores and reads artifacts by digest on a real operator-only hub: an unlicensed store, a damaged stored copy, a stopped hub, a hub switched to team mode and a disconnection are each reported, never retried
publishing to a real hub needs an activated license and a role that may write, and a damaged stored copy, an expired session, a stopped hub and a disconnection are each reported, never retried
two people review the same evidence on a real hub: the decision made against a stale history is refused as a conflict and recorded once renewed
a capture started from a saved listener stops when Cancel capture is pressed, and reopening after a kill starts nothing
a note's text the window retained survives a kill, and text it had not yet retained comes back whole or not at all
cancelling an import while it writes its case stops it there, registers nothing, and the window says it was cancelled
a keyboard-only person opens the sample, verifies and inspects a case, moves between regions, resizes and scales, and recovers from refusals
a delivered license file is activated here, used by the command line with nothing named, renewed in place, saved, and deactivated only when asked
administrator activation choices, export and clock correction agree with the command line
a project is backed up and verified, backed up again with no project open, held to a quota and restored into a separate project
a staged update is checked from Settings, its rollback copy taken and shown, and refused once its package is altered, with nothing installed
an archive keeps the project, and Delete from this computer is refused once the project changed and while a protected package is retained
an earlier project document is listed with when and why it was kept, opened read-only and restored as a separate project, and a copy damaged since is refused
on a full disk an archive, a delete, a staged update and a restore are refused with the project kept, the restore's unfinished folder is shown, and the delete completes once there is room
one case is archived and deleted from its row, leaving the rest of the project, and then the project is deleted against its verified archive
the window's own paths over the largest case a bundle admits, timed as a person waits for them
a person's own export becomes a registered, searchable case in a new project and reopens where they left it
a report's value-free support summary is exported under the project's sharing policy into a new folder, and the command line verifies it and refuses it once changed
a new project completes import, duplicate regression, report, redacted export and restart (required derived check: false)
a new project completes import, duplicate regression, report, redacted export and restart (required derived check: true)
Security lists the environment active while a send holds its connection, and checked after an explicit check
projects are created, reopened from Projects, removed from recents, renamed and located after a move
a control is retired only once the person confirms it, writes no new package afterwards and still opens the package it wrote, exactly as readmit protect retire decides
a corpus generated and scanned in the window is the command line's corpus, manifest and benchmark
a raw file is inspected and copied in the window exactly as the command line inspects and copies it
a failure is minimized by one reviewed series: refused without a reset, stopped mid-trial, bounded by its trial limit and reduced, as the downstream system and the command line record it
a replay cancelled while its acknowledgement is held leaves that delivery uncertain, and nothing sends it again
selected case messages are previewed as readmit replay previews them and sent to an independent downstream system once, only after explicit approval
a variant is edited, undone and refused where it cannot be saved, and saved as the revision project show reads
a check group, a profile and a scenario are created in the library, and the scenario generates a synthetic case from its saved seed and base time without running a test

a suite of two tests with an environment's bindings, two data rows, an explicit override, a dependency and coverage is saved in one Save and reopens whole, runs through its exact review, and reports its jobs as they ended
a suite version changed by another editor after approval review refuses the old approval without sending or recording it
a suite version is approved as a local baseline and, as its own decision that deploys nothing, for an environment, and that approval is marked changed once the environment it bound moves
two retained runs of one test compare a changed check definition as a changed check, never as a regression
saved check groups are decided against retained runs assertion by assertion as the command line re-decides them, passing, failing, unobserved and without evidence, and nothing is sent
retained runs are chosen from the keyboard, Back restores the choice, a check group is decided read-only, a report is handed off, and a compact window shows a run alone
a job is written once for a saved test, previewed against the environment its prepared inputs bind and refused under a runner for another, and a schedule policy for it is exported and opened again
a runner's setup is refused while the runner would refuse it, reviewed, exported once for another host and read unchanged by the command line's runner
a staged runner update is verified against the pinned deployment key without being run, and an unsigned or a foreign candidate is refused as the command line refuses it
a customer runner executes the saved test once against the downstream system through the real hub, to the verdict the window's own run and the command line's runner reach

a runner whose hub grant went stale is refused until the window's grant revision is installed, a job whose delivery is never acknowledged stays uncertain, and its job id is never run again by the window or the command line
a filter applied stores nothing, a saved view shows exactly its messages after the case is reopened, and it is renamed and removed in place
a name another view holds and a views document a later release wrote are refused, and neither changes what is stored
Pause acknowledged during a real active scheduled send lets that run finish and prevents the queued occurrence from dispatching

a suite's schedule is enabled by the hub scheduler's acknowledgement, a repeated command is recorded once, an unacknowledged change stays Pending across a window restart until it is sent again, and Delete removes it
an expired installed hub license prevents an enabled schedule from dispatching and keeps its history readable

at its slot the hub scheduler dispatches nothing for a paused schedule, refuses and pauses one whose runner has no grant or whose pinned suite changed, and never catches up a slot it missed while stopped
a note restored after a reopen cannot be stored once the activation is released, and stays retained

a synthetic demonstration packet is generated into a new folder, verified as readmit report verify verifies it, prepared into runnable copies outside it and refused once changed, labelled synthetic throughout
sequence changes the engine refuses are refused in its words, and the rest are previewed and saved as the one derived case readmit diff and project show read
